title: Invert Binary Tree
notes: Recursively swap left and right subtrees. Base case: root is null. Time: O(n), Space: O(h).

title: Two Sum
notes:
Classic hash map complement pattern.
Iterate through array, check if target - num exists in map. If yes, return indices.
Time: O(n)
Space: O(n)

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
notes:
Sliding window with two pointers (left & right) and a character frequency map. When duplicate is found, shrink left until duplicate is removed. Maintain max window length.
Time: O(n)
Space: O(min(m, n))

title: LRU Cache
notes:
Doubly Linked List + Hash Map.
Dummy head and tail nodes make edge cases (remove/insert) trivial. Hash map stores key -> Node reference for O(1) access.
Needed a quick peek at the dummy head/tail structure setup.

title: Trapping Rain Water
notes:
Two pointers approach:
Left and right pointers moving inward, keeping track of maxLeft and maxRight.
Water trapped at current index is determined by the minimum of maxLeft and maxRight.
Full solution review was needed for the two-pointer optimization from O(n) space to O(1) space.

title: Valid Parentheses
notes:
Stack-based matching. Push opening brackets or use a map of closing -> opening brackets. Check if stack is empty at the end.
Time: O(n)
Space: O(n)

title: Coin Change
notes:
Bottom-up 1D DP table.
dp[i] = min coins to make amount i. Initialize with amount + 1 (infinity).
Transition: for coin in coins: if i - coin >= 0: dp[i] = min(dp[i], 1 + dp[i - coin]).
Time: O(amount * len(coins))
Space: O(amount)

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
notes:
Binary search on the partition of the smaller array.
Ensure left partition contains (m + n + 1) / 2 elements. Check maxLeftA <= minRightB and maxLeftB <= minRightA.
Time: O(log(min(m, n)))
Space: O(1)
